svg.title: Every shape can report its area; circles and rectangles are kinds of shape
svg.desc: Class diagram. Interface Drawable: operations +draw(canvas: Canvas): void. Abstract class Shape: attributes #origin: Point; operations +area(): float {abstract}, +moveTo(p: Point): void. Class Circle: attributes -radius: float; operations +area(): float. Class Rectangle: attributes -width: float, -height: float; operations +area(): float. Class Square. Shape implements Drawable. Circle is a kind of Shape. Rectangle is a kind of Shape. Square is a kind of Rectangle.
